discard_without_reclassification: transformed patch fails a visible check
transformed patch passes all hidden checks
candidate_acceptance_rule.hard_negative: transformed patch passes all frozen visible checks and fails at least one frozen independent hidden oracle in both environments
candidate_acceptance_rule.oracle_positive: official reference fix after dual-environment visible and hidden checks

priority_rule: apply the first applicable transform by ascending priority; never choose by candidate outcome
prohibited_adaptation: do not change transform priority after observing a source-task outcome
do not add a task-specific transform
do not retain a candidate because it produces a larger model effect
do not inspect model output before candidate labels are frozen

source_task_boundary.candidate_with_no_applicable_transform: replace only by frozen reserve order in P4

transforms.applicability: reference diff changes at least two files
transforms.operation: retain the first hash-ordered changed source file and omit one later changed source file
transforms.scientific_intent: partial fix that leaves one independently changed source surface unresolved

transforms.applicability: reference diff contains at least two hunks
transforms.operation: retain all but one hash-ordered non-test hunk
transforms.scientific_intent: partial fix that omits one localized semantic component

transforms.applicability: reference diff contains at least two separated edit blocks
transforms.operation: retain all but one hash-ordered edit block and recompute the unified-diff hunk header
transforms.scientific_intent: within-hunk partial fix without adding new code

transforms.applicability: reference diff changes at least three non-header lines
transforms.operation: restore one hash-ordered reference edit while retaining at least one other reference edit
transforms.scientific_intent: minimal partial reversion for a multi-line reference fix
